meta.problem:
Eric had two weeks to finish a science project. He was able to finish it in only nine days. How would you describe the number of weeks it took him to finish the project? Show the fraction on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem? Convert it to mixed fraction form if it will help you.

hintsPerCorrectStep: Numerator represents number of parts out of the whole. What are you trying to count in this problem?
Think about how many days it took for Eric to finish his project.
Enter 9 in the box.
You are trying to describe number of day as number of weeks. Try to remember what you would do when you want to convert number of pencils into number of dozens.
Think about how many days are in a week.
Enter 7 in the box.
If you want to convert the fraction to a mixed number, click "Convert", if not, simply click on the number line to place your fraction to complete the problem.
